content.content: The from-source install instructions clone the source home the hosting decision names: the clone URL the README gives is that home, and the build runs at that checkout. Fail on a clone URL that names any home other than the recorded one — name it.
content.rationale: The from-source route is the one install path the release does not produce: it rests on the source being public, not on what cargo-dist ships. The hosting prerequisite is a decision in words, so its gate is a read-through of the instructions against that home.
